comment: How a session's label / task (trimmed text) and meta/<key> (one trailing newline removed, nothing trimmed) are read from disk. Read by the tests of packages/core (session-state.ts readDeclared) and apps/agent (api.go ReadDeclared), so the two readers cannot drift (#191). A file that is not UTF-8 is treated as absent, as for role (role-cases.json): label / task read as "", a meta key is left out (value null). Trimming is JavaScript's String.prototype.trim: U+FEFF is trimmed, U+0085 is not.
